title: Predicting transcriptional regulators in plants in the era of artificial intelligence.
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦植物转录调控因子的AI预测，涵盖多组学整合与深度学习，但未涉及TF-DNA三维互作建模或分子模拟，属于广义TF调控网络预测，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: Identifying transcriptional regulators that control important biological pathways in plants is fundamental to understanding regulatory mechanisms, network hierarchy, and phenotypic variation. This remains challenging because transcription factors (TFs) and their targets operate within highly interconnected, dynamic, and often redundant regulatory networks. Over the past two decades, advances in omics technologies, sequencing data generation, and computational tools have shifted gene discovery from single-gene studies to network-level investigation. At the same time, these advances have created a new challenge: how to extract biologically meaningful regulatory relationships from increasingly complex and high-dimensional datasets. Recent progress in multi-omics integration and artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning (ML), deep learning, and emerging foundation-model approaches, is beginning to address this challenge and is reshaping how transcriptional regulators, targets, and regulatory relationships are predicted in plants. In this review, we summarize advances in network-enabled gene discovery, discuss how multi-omics and AI are transforming transcriptional target prediction, and consider how these developments may lead to predictive models of plant gene regulation with applications in crop improvement and synthetic biology.
abstract_zh: 识别控制植物重要生物学途径的转录调控因子，是理解调控机制、网络层级结构及表型变异的基础。这一任务仍具挑战性，因为转录因子（TFs）及其靶标在高度互联、动态且常冗余的调控网络中运作。过去二十年间，组学技术、测序数据生成及计算工具的进步，已将基因发现从单基因研究转向网络层面分析。同时，这些进展也带来了新挑战：如何从日益复杂和高维的数据集中提取具有生物学意义的调控关系。多组学整合与人工智能（AI）的最新进展，包括机器学习（ML）、深度学习及新兴的基础模型方法，正开始应对这一挑战，并重塑植物中转录调控因子、靶标及调控关系的预测方式。在本综述中，我们总结了网络赋能基因发现的进展，探讨了多组学与AI如何变革转录靶标预测，并思考这些发展如何促成植物基因调控的预测模型，及其在作物改良和合成生物学中的应用。
